transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello! I'm Dora, and I'm here to help with any questions you may have about your cataract surgery recovery. Do you have any questions about your surgery or recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do have a few questions. When can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You can start with light exercise, including gardening, about 1 week after surgery. Just be gentle with yourself and avoid heavy lifting or bending. It's also a good idea to wear protective eyewear while gardening to prevent any accidental water or debris from getting in your eyes.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you! That’s really helpful. Another thing I wanted to ask is when I can start using my eye gel for dry eyes again?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You should continue to use your eye drops as prescribed. If you're running out, your GP should be able to provide some more. And if you were using any eye drops before your operation, such as for glaucoma, or for dry eyes, it's safe to continue using them, unless you've been told otherwise.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Great, thanks for the clarification. I'm also experiencing a lot of sensitivity to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Some sensitivity to light is normal, especially as your eyes adjust to the new lenses. However, if it's severe or accompanied by redness and pain, we may need to assess it further. Mild sensitivity is usually okay, and you can try wearing sunglasses when you're outside.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: That makes sense. Lastly, should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: It's common for vision to be a bit blurry in the first week after surgery. But it should improve quickly and settle down over time. If your vision is still blurry or getting worse, we may need to check it to make sure everything is okay.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you for all the information. I don't have any more questions.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: It was my pleasure to help. I'm glad I could answer your questions about your cataract surgery recovery. Do you feel like all your questions have been answered?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I feel much better informed now. Thank you again for your help!
